papers.title: Illustrative study: reinforcement learning for task scheduling
papers.abstract: This fictional example describes a reinforcement learning scheduler that selects workers using task features and previous worker performance. Quality and execution cost are considered together. No real experimental results are provided.

papers.title: Illustrative study: checking literature review evidence
papers.abstract: This fictional example describes checking claims in literature reviews against supplied paper abstracts. Each summary keeps its paper identifier and a verbatim evidence excerpt. Evidence checks alone do not establish that all generated claims are correct.
